name: American Express
description: American Express issues premium charge and credit cards to consumers, small businesses and large companies, and also runs its own payment network and signs the merchants that accept its cards. It is paid in three ways: a discount fee charged to merchants on every purchase (about half of revenue), annual card fees from members (about 14% and growing fastest), and interest on balances members carry (net interest income about $17.4 billion). It both issues cards and runs the network and merchant relationships (the GMNS segment). It is the fourth largest general-purpose card network by purchase volume, behind Visa, China UnionPay and Mastercard.

employees.note: About 76,800 colleagues: about 25,900 in the US and about 50,900 outside.

businessLines.name: U.S. Consumer Services (USCS)
businessLines.how: Card fees and interest from US consumer and small-business cardholders plus the merchant discount on their spending; fees are annual, interest varies with balances carried.

revenue.period: FY2025 segment revenues net of interest expense

businessLines.name: Commercial Services (CS)
businessLines.how: Card fees, interest and merchant discount on spending by US small businesses, mid-sized companies and large corporations.

businessLines.name: International Card Services (ICS)
businessLines.how: Card fees, interest and merchant discount from cardholders outside the US.

businessLines.name: Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS)
businessLines.how: Signs merchants and acquirers to accept the card and earns the discount rate (a fee on each purchase) plus network and partner fees, including from cards issued by others on the Amex network; segment margin 51.1%.
